title: EDGECAM
summary: 掌上 DV 取景相机：冷调/胶片双滤镜、1–3× 平滑变焦、拍照与录像。  Pocket DV camera for CardputerZero: cool/f
description:
EDGECAM 把 CardputerZero 变成一台掌上 DV 取景相机。全屏 320×170 HUD 显示 REC/时间码、电量、实时曝光和变焦条，按 I 可以一键隐藏全部界面，只留干净画面。

NORMAL 是冷色调（蓝青高光、冷阴影），KARAX 是暖调胶片（颗粒、暗角、成片泛光）。1.0–3.0× 数码变焦带缓动，按住 9/0 可以连续变焦；拍照为 1640×1232，按下快门的瞬间定格当前画面，没有进度条；R 录制带滤镜的 320×170 H.264 视频。

基于 IMX219 定焦镜头（约 1 米），完全离线：不联网、无账号、无遥测，照片和视频只保存在本机。


EDGECAM turns the CardputerZero into a tiny DV viewfinder camera. A full-screen 320×170 HUD shows REC/timecode, battery, live exposure and a zoom bar; press I to hide the whole overlay and keep a clean frame.

NORMAL is a cool blue-teal grade, KARAX is a warm film look with grain, vignette and halation in stills. Digital zoom ranges from 1.0× to 3.0× with smooth easing — hold 9/0 to keep zooming. Snapshots are 1640×1232 and freeze the exact frame at the moment you press the shutter, with no progress bar. R records the filtered viewfinder to a 320×170 H.264 clip.

Built around the fixed-focus IMX219 (~1 m), fully offline: no accounts, no network, no telemetry; photos and clips stay on the device.
